source_hypotheses.required: A normalized second conic over Q with positive semantic coefficient b; a proof of the s=0 branch.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Three detector coefficients B=n^2/E and scalar coefficient 42r, each strictly positive on the unchanged parent domain.
source_hypotheses.justification: The proof records the unchanged positivity arguments and the scalar square absorption. Version 13 provides the prior template, not acceptance of this application.

constructed_objects.required: The conic and all private square slots, with exact normalization.
constructed_objects.constructed: Compiled 389-variable IR with H=17E-h for detectors and H=-184460384539603E-1181808857731824h for the scalar.
constructed_objects.justification: The producer decodes H from metadata; the separate checker reconstructs H and b from the actual conic coefficients and compares the whole polynomial.

index_domain_coverage.required: Both s!=0 and s=0 for every rational solution on the retained domain; no extra inverse guard.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The nonzero branch uses H/s and q/s; the zero branch uses positive b to force H=q=0 and chooses v=Q=Q2=0.
index_domain_coverage.justification: These two cases exhaust Q. There is no indexed Euler system in this local transformation; the global inherited theorem is not changed.

transition_maps.required: Maps in both directions that satisfy every old/new equation.
transition_maps.constructed: Old-to-new division by s on the nonzero branch and an explicit zero lift; new-to-old H=sv, q=sQ, q2=s^2Q2, s2=s^2 and h=(sv-rest)/alpha.
transition_maps.justification: The old second-conic and q2 residuals are s^2 times new residuals up to nonzero constant normalization; the old square residual is identically zero. Reverse transport needs no division by s.

limiting_object_identity.required: The object consumed downstream must be the original normalized pole block with the same input.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: All outside coordinates, b, E, T, input x0 and parameter S are retained; the old private witnesses are reconstructed exactly.
limiting_object_identity.justification: No limit is used here. Exact residual identities and unchanged outside consumers establish the relevant object identity; no merely proportional pole input is substituted.

coefficient_conventions.required: Rational witnesses, exact fixed nonzero affine normalization constants, quadratic residuals and input-fixed scaling.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The compiled scalar h differs from H, and the scalar conic coefficient 42r differs from physical input 42rW^2. The original thirteen diagonal factors are reused.
coefficient_conventions.justification: All calculations use Fraction / integer arithmetic. Row normalization uses nonzero rational scalars. The unchanged diagonal checker reconstructs every residual and quartic coefficient.

local_conditions.required: Preserve the original real domain and all finite-place consumers.
local_conditions.constructed: The positive-domain premises lie in the 341 unchanged outside residuals; all local orders, primes, anchor and height constants are retained.
local_conditions.justification: The new-to-old polynomial reconstruction works without positivity. Positivity is used only for the old-to-new zero lift and is justified by unchanged parent arguments. This does not re-prove those global dependencies.

exceptional_cases.required: Handle s=0 and all signs/zero choices of other private witnesses.
exceptional_cases.constructed: At s=0, 17bq^2+3H^2=0 forces H=q=0; the stored old h can be nonzero. No division by q, H or v occurs.
exceptional_cases.justification: The affine normalization constants are fixed nonzero rationals. Reconstructing old solutions works even when a new private factor is zero.

downstream_consumption.required: Exclude outside use of repurposed/deleted coordinates and preserve the polynomial input projection.
downstream_consumption.constructed: For each of four prefixes the only consumers of h,q,q2,s2 are Bh.definition, q2.definition, s2.definition and secondConic.
downstream_consumption.justification: The checker scans every residual, verifies all 341 exterior rows unchanged, verifies the four deleted rows and preserves x0. The parent scaling checker then verifies all 26,235 quartic coefficients.

historicalDisposition: Prior justification found for the factored-conic template; this application uses different compiled normalizations and requires fresh review.

dependencyImpact: Only four local conic representations change. No acceptance of the inherited detector, height, scalar or arithmetic argument is supplied. The parent global assumptions remain conditional.
